Add bullet “for NPDCCH associated with C-RNTI during random access procedure in a Type-2 CSS in an NB-IoT carrier configured by SystemInformationBlockType22-NB when interferenceRandomisationConfig is used, or”

(Rel-19, 36.211, NB_IOTenh-Core, TEI19, CR0581, Cat F) is agreed.

items.interpretation: The agreed reply preserves both LOS-conditioned negligible loss and non-LOS potentially non-negligible loss, plus explicit lack of consensus on considering the latter case. It does not claim consensus on non-LOS negligible loss.

required_operative_roles.operative_role_literal: Reply to Q2 of R1-2506707 as the following:
Assuming line-of-sight condition for the duration of the call, no change in large scale parameters
using an NTN TDL-C channel model
16 or 64 packets consecutively lost is negligible
up to 10% packet error rate
For the case of line-of-sight not being guaranteed
probability of having 16 or 64 packets consecutively lost may not be negligible. RAN1 has not reached consensus on whether to consider this case.

items.interpretation: Four endorsed RAN2 answers retain per-cell/group-TRP scope, ARP implementation freedom, no cross-cell uniqueness requirement, per-cell versus PFL distinction, and Rel-19 exclusion of cell-free PRS-only TPs.

required_operative_roles.operative_role_literal: Regarding the RAN2 LS R1-2506737, the following response from RAN1 is endorsed.
an associated ID is configured per cell
It is provided for a group of TRP(s) in the same cell, not for one specific TRP within a cell.
A group of TRP(s) in the same cell can have only one TRP.
It is up to network implementation whether the associated ID is related to the identification of the location of ARP(s).
Associated ID(s) are not required to be unique across different cells.
The associated ID is not PFL specific.
in Rel-19, the associated ID cannot be used to implicitly indicate the consistency of location coordinates of such PRS-only TPs, as the PRS-only TPs are not associated with a cell.
